name: Over the Cloud: Lost Planet
source:
The mankind found an unknown ore in a comet that crashed on Earth…
Because of this, they accomplished to develop an extraordinary civilization. The speed of scientific development increased rapidly and faced a new civilized age. Old age spaceships became artifacts and were valued enough to consider them as historical pieces.
These new spaceships went deep into the space to collect even more ores. They named this ore, Oort-nite. However, one day, monsters appeared across the world and attacked mankind simultaneously.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1037340/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
人类在一颗坠落地球的彗星中发现了未知矿石……
正因如此，人类发展出非凡的文明。科学进步速度急剧提升，文明迎来新的时代。旧时代的宇宙飞船成为遗物，珍贵到足以被视为历史文物。

这些新型宇宙飞船深入太空，收集更多矿石，并将这种矿石命名为Oort-nite。然而某天，怪物遍布世界，同时袭击了人类。

[来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1037340/]Steam[/url]]
